title: Sollfege Smart Electronics IPO Details
intro:
Sollfege Smart Electronics IPO is a fixed issue price of ₹21.78 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 39.60 lakh shares of ₹21.78 crore.

Sollfege Smart Electronics IPO opens for subscription on Sep 30, 2026 and closes on Oct 5, 2026. The allotment for the Sollfege Smart Electronics IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 6, 2026. Sollfege Smart Electronics IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 8, 2026.

Sollfege Smart Electronics IPO is set final issue price at ₹55 per share. The lot size for an application is 2,000 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,20,000 (4,000 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (6,000 shares), amounting to ₹3,30,000.

Finshore Management Services Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Sollfege Smart Electronics IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 2012, Sollfege Smart Electronics Limited is engaged in the premium segment of audio, video, home automation, smart living, lifestyle electronics, and wellness solutions. The company is focused on delivering integrated and technology-driven solutions that combine high-quality products with design, convenience, and functionality. It operates through a combination of showrooms, experience centres, and an online platform, enabling customers to experience, evaluate, and purchase products across both residential and commercial use cases.

Over the years, Sollfege has evolved from a traditional audio-video distributor into a comprehensive solutions provider in the premium electronics space. Its offerings include home theatre systems, audio solutions, video solutions, smart home automation, lighting control, climate control, lifestyle electronics, and connected living solutions. The company caters to customers who seek refined, modern, and seamless living experiences, with a strong emphasis on product quality, user experience, and end-to-end service support.

Sollfege’s business model is designed around an experience-first approach. Its experience centres are created to reflect real living environments, allowing customers to interact with and test products before making a purchase decision. This approach is particularly relevant in the premium segment, where product demonstration, customization, and technical consultation play an important role in influencing buying behaviour. The company’s sales and technical teams work closely with customers to understand their requirements and provide tailored solutions that meet both functional and aesthetic expectations.

The company has also built strong relationships with globally recognized brands, national distributors, architects, interior designers, builders, and project partners. These relationships have helped Sollfege strengthen its market position and expand its presence in both retail and project-based segments. Through these partnerships, the company is able to offer reliable, high-quality products and execute complex integration projects across residential, commercial, and institutional spaces.

Sollfege operates across multiple geographies in India and has established its presence through showrooms in Kolkata, Gurgaon, and Bhubaneswar. It serves both B2C and B2B customers and participates in exhibitions, events, and digital marketing initiatives to strengthen brand visibility and customer engagement. The company continues to focus on expanding its presence in key markets while enhancing its product portfolio, service network, and digital reach.

With its premium positioning, customer-centric approach, and integrated solution offerings, Sollfege Smart Electronics Limited aims to further strengthen its presence in the premium audio-video and smart automation industry in India.

faqs.question: How to apply in Sollfege Smart Electronics IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Sollfege Smart Electronics IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Sollfege Smart Electronics IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Sollfege Smart Electronics IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Sollfege Smart Electronics IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: How to apply for Sollfege Smart Electronics IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Sollfege Smart Electronics IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Sollfege Smart Electronics IPO will be done on Tuesday, October 6, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Wed, Oct 7, 2026 . Check the Sollfege Smart Electronics IPO allotment status .
